attributes.name: Demonling
attributes.powers:
The Demonling is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. Before you act, succeed at a Wisdom or Perception 7 check or the Demonling may not be evaded, and the difficulty of checks to defeat the Demonling is increased by 3.

If undefeated, move to a random location.
